roles.title: Vice President, Product Management, Core AI Foundations
roles.description:
In this role, you will lead the product management function for all of the AI Foundation organization. You will directly partner with and support the lead of the AIF organization. As a leader of the product management function, you will partner with the following AIF Pillars: Context & Understanding, Data Intelligence, Integrated Software Platforms, Product Development Ecosystems, and AI Acceleration.
The Core team builds the technical foundation behind Google’s flagship products. We are owners and advocates for the underlying design elements, developer platforms, product components, and infrastructure at Google. These are the essential building blocks for excellent, safe, and coherent experiences for our users and drive the pace of innovation for every developer. We look across Google’s products to build central solutions, break down technical barriers and strengthen existing systems. As the Core team, we have a mandate and a unique opportunity to impact important technical decisions across the company.
Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
US: $550,000 (USD) + 80% bonus target + equity + benefits
Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities:
Partner across product areas, engineering, and AI Research to align roadmaps and ensure a cohesive customer experience. Articulate product vision to internal customers, partners, and senior leaders to drive key priorities.

Synthesize 10X ideas into an actionable product strategy and multi-year roadmap for the AIF organization.

Recruit, mentor, and manage a product management team that partners seamlessly with engineering. 

Make high-stakes prioritization decisions under time and resource constraints to best support Google’s needs.

Coach senior PM talent and foster a culture aligned with Google's strategic goals.

Qualifications:
Minimum qualifications:
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

20 years of experience in the full scope of product management (i.e., developing product outlook and roadmap, working with customers and driving development, coordinating launches, and ensuring post-launch success).

Preferred qualifications:
Master's degree or PhD.

Strong builder or operator of large-scale infrastructure platforms and distributed systems, with technical knowledge of public/private cloud, GPUs, virtualization, and containerization.

These responsibilities, combined with the mandate to proactively expand the scope of support operations and manage a team through hyper-growth in a cost efficient way, necessitates a leader with the proven strategic foresight, cross-functional leadership impact, and organizational scaling capabilities.

Advise leadership on security risks, threat landscape, and operational health. Promote automation, scalability, and reliability across security operations.

roles.title: Director Principal Technical Program Manager, Delivery Enablement and Field Integration, Global Data Centers
roles.description:
The Modular Manufacturing & Integration organization is leading an industry-defining transformation in how Google delivers technical infrastructure for the AI era. Transitioning away from conventional, on-site, purpose-built civil construction, our mission is to industrialize data center delivery through mass-assembled, standardized modules and off-site manufacturing.
By pushing labor-intensive assembly, systems integration, and quality testing upstream into controlled factory environments, we enable rapid "square wave" capacity delivery—turning on gigawatt-scale AI compute, liquid cooling, power distribution, and network fabric with unprecedented velocity upon site arrival. 
You will serve as the premier field technical authority and operational bridgehead ensuring Google’s manufactured modular infrastructure products land, interconnect, and integrate seamlessly across global sites. In this founding leadership role—initially operating as a high-leverage technical leader with the mandate to recruit and scale a team of Field Support Engineers and Site Integration TPMs—you will establish the operational standard for how modular data center products are deployed.
Operating much like a Director of Field Support/Field Applications Engineering from an advanced industrial equipment manufacturer, you and your function are the technical experts who walk deployment sites, local general contractors, and external partners through their initial interactions with our modular solutions. Your scope begins as factory modules arrive on-site and culminates once units are safely offloaded, rigged, precision-set, seismically anchored, and have all mechanical, electrical, fluid, and fiber interconnects mated and verified for handover to local commissioning teams. Crucially, you will advocate for a disciplined field-to-factory feedback loop, partnering with manufacturing and design engineering to systematically engineer friction out of the field deployment critical path.
The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide. 
We're the driving force behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our cutting-edge AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more.
Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.  

US: $281000 - $391000 (USD) + 30% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities:
Author and enforce global field engineering standards, detailed rigging playbooks, crane layout guidelines, site logistics procedures for offloading, handling, and positioning.

Lead the on-site technical execution of initial modular prototype and production deployments worldwide (requiring up to 75% travel during peak waves).

Own physical module landing process through interconnect completion. Provide subject-matter expertise on heavy-lift logistics, tandem crane lifts, and tight-tolerance rigging, collaborating closely with local site GC's and EHS authorities.

Feed structured, data-driven field insights directly back to Manufacturing & Industrial Engineering and Design Engineering teams.

Build, mentor, and lead a team of Field Support Engineers and Site Integration TPMs. Drive end-to-end alignment to compress arrival-to-interconnect cycle times.

Qualifications:
Minimum qualifications:
Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Civil/Structural Engineering, Construction Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

15 years of technical program management, field engineering, or industrial equipment delivery experience managing physical infrastructure landings.

Preferred qualifications:
Master’s degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Operations, or an MBA with a technical undergraduate degree.

Experience developing rigging plans, heavy-lift logistics, crane positioning layouts, and structural setting of heavy pre-fabricated or modular assemblies.

Experience with Mechanical, Electrical, and Plumbing (MEP) interconnects, including fluid quick-connect couplings, electrical busway tie-ins, and high-density fiber topologies.

Experience architecting formal closed-loop corrective action processes (e.g., FRACAS, 8D) that convert jobsite assembly challenges into upstream factory design modifications.

roles.title: Director of Product Management, Applied AI Enterprise Verticals, DeepMind
roles.description:
At Google, we put our users first. The world is always changing, so we need Product Managers who are continuously adapting and excited to work on products that affect millions of people every day. 

In this role, you will work cross-functionally to guide products from conception to launch by connecting the technical and business worlds. You can break down complex problems into steps that drive product development.

One of the many reasons Google consistently brings innovative, world-changing products to market is because of the collaborative work we do in Product Management. Our team works closely with creative engineers, designers, marketers, etc. to help design and develop technologies that improve access to the world's information.  We're responsible for guiding products throughout the execution cycle, focusing specifically on analyzing, positioning, packaging, promoting, and tailoring our solutions to our users.

DeepMind’s Applied AI team seeks a Director of Product Management to bridge cutting-edge research and real-world enterprise transformation. You will partner with industry leaders across media, entertainment, and creative sectors, alongside research engineers and cross-functional teams, to identify, scope, and deploy frontier AI solutions.
As a bridge between research and industry, our mission is two-fold: deploy breakthrough AI solutions that unlock tangible business value, and channel insights from messy real-world environments back into our development processes to shape future research trajectories.
You will construct technical solutions, conduct rigorous evaluations, manage complex engagements from discovery to delivery, and empower a talented team of product managers across multiple sectors. If you thrive in ambiguous environments, this role offers unparalleled opportunities to advance frontier generative AI by working on challenging enterprise problems.
Artificial intelligence will be one of humanity’s most transformative inventions. At Google DeepMind, we are a pioneering AI lab with exceptional interdisciplinary teams focused on advancing AI development to solve complex global challenges and accelerate high-quality product innovation for billions of users. We use our technologies for widespread public benefit and scientific discovery, ensuring safety and ethics are always our highest priority.
We are pushing the boundaries across multiple domains. Our global teams offer diverse learning opportunities and varied career pathways for those driven to achieve exceptional results through collective effort.
Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.  

US: $352000 - $391000 (USD) + 30% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities:
Lead discovery discussions with enterprise executives and technical teams, maintaining contemporary understanding of AI advances to intuitively identify, predict, and scope high-impact generative AI opportunities delivering business value.

Drive scoping and progress of engagements programmatically and technically, focusing on building rigorous model evaluations, identifying loss patterns, and transforming complex data to systematically test product hypotheses.

Lead, develop, and mentor a high-performing team of Applied AI product managers to scale organizational impact across multiple cutting-edge AI models and global industry sectors.

Contribute to DeepMind-wide strategic initiatives, advancing product thinking and accuracy to complement research while proactively mapping emerging enterprise opportunities directly to evolving model capabilities.

Orchestrate cross-functional collaboration across DeepMind Research Engineers, client executives, go-to-market, partnership, and legal teams to establish firm foundations for all customer engagements and support ongoing frontier model development.

Qualifications:
Minimum qualifications:
Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

15 years of experience in product management.

5 years of experience in people management, managing a team of product managers.

Domain experience in AI/ML (trajectories, evaluation, and context knowledge).

Preferred qualifications:
Product and software experience with advanced AI/LLMs (fine-tuning, agent harnesses, MCP/UCP protocols), AI safety, adversarial analysis, and proactive ethical risk mitigation.

Track record of translating nuanced user insights into intuitive AI experiences while delivering compelling technical presentations to executive leadership.

Expertise designing AI evaluation frameworks and metrics, translating model behaviors and performance insights into strategic, product enhancements in ambiguous environments.

Success building, mentoring, and leading product management teams, driving cross-functional alignment across engineering, legal, marketing, and go-to-market to deliver innovative multi-industry solutions.

roles.title: Director, Applied AI Research and Collaborations, Future of Work
roles.description:
As the Director of Applied AI Research & Future of Work, you will architect Google’s strategic narratives and empirical research agenda on how artificial intelligence and emerging technologies reshape work, skills, and organizational structures. Leveraging deep data and telemetry across Google’s Product Areas—including Cloud, Gemini, Workspace, and DeepMind—you will lead rigorous, longitudinal applied research on changing role dynamics, leadership requirements, and corporate culture.
You will establish cross-functional research initiatives across Google Cloud, DeepMind, and Google Research, while cultivating strong partnerships with academic institutions and economists. Additionally, you will drive global thought leadership by translating applied research into enterprise customer collaborations and executive forums.
Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.  

US: $262000 - $364000 (USD) + 30% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities:
Design and execute longitudinal, data-backed research initiatives evaluating the economic, behavioral, and organizational impacts of applied AI and agentic workflows.

Translate empirical research findings into actionable workforce strategies, leadership models, and executive frameworks for Google leadership and enterprise customer engagements.

Lead cross-functional research partnerships across Google Research, DeepMind, Cloud, and academic economists to co-author and publish pioneering workplace studies.

Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative or social science field (e.g., Statistics, Economics, Computer Science, Psychology), or equivalent practical experience.

Experience translating technical findings into narratives for executive audiences.

Experience utilizing large-scale product telemetry and behavioral datasets to uncover organizational trends.

Experience advising senior executives on AI-driven organizational design and future-of-work strategy.

Deep familiarity with modern generative AI architectures, agentic systems, and Google’s product ecosystem.

Track record of publishing or leading applied research on AI adoption, labor economics, or workforce transformation.

roles.title: Director, Engineering, Sovereign Environments, SRE, Cloud
roles.description:
As part of Technical Infrastructure, Google’s Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) is an engineering discipline for building and running large-scale, massively distributed, fault-tolerant systems. Our Site Reliability Engineers (SREs) come from both software engineering and systems engineering backgrounds and specialize in designing, building and maintaining large-scale production services. SRE ensures that Google’s services - both our internally critical and our externally visible systems - have reliability and uptime appropriate to users’ needs and a fast rate of improvement while keeping an ever-watchful eye on capacity and performance. Along with a set of engineering approaches, SRE is a mindset of running better production systems. We build our own creative engineering solutions to operations problems. Much of our software development focuses on optimizing existing systems, building infrastructure and eliminating work through automation. SRE is responsible for the big picture, determining how our systems relate to each other, using a breadth of tools and approaches to solve a broad spectrum of problems. Practices, such as limiting time spent on operational work, blameless postmortems and proactive identification of potential outages, factor into iterative improvement that is key to both product quality and interesting, dynamic day-to-day work. SRE’s culture of intellectual curiosity, problem solving and openness is key to its success.
Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. We're proud to be our engineers' engineers and love voiding warranties by taking things apart so we can rebuild them. We keep our networks up and running, ensuring our users have the best and fastest experience possible.
Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.  

US: $307000 - $427000 (USD) + 30% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities:
Drive the transformation of Google’s internal operational processes, tools, and practices to enable partners to operate the cloud autonomously while maintaining service parity and Google rollout velocity.

Ensure that SRE principles (SLOs, alerting, runbooks, diagnostics) are built directly into the shipped software so external infrastructure operators can operate it reliably without Google's intervention.

Redesign incident response, monitoring, and debugging paradigms for universes where Google SREs do not have ambient access.

Oversee support tiers, including extended workforce who act as Level 3 support or manage canonical pre-production/staging environments.

Manage reliability for a massive, globally distributed "fleet of fleets." This includes managing lifecycle operations (Day 0 turnup, Day 1 install, Day 2 repairs) in addition to software reliability.

Qualifications:
Minimum qualifications:
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

15 years of experience with system design, algorithms, data structures, complexity analysis and software design or with Unix/Linux systems, IP networking, performance and application issues.

Experience with container orchestration (Kubernetes/GKE) operating outside of public cloud data centers.

Preferred qualifications:
Capable of technical deep-dives into code, operating systems and storage, yet verbally and cognitively agile enough to hold your own in a strategy discussion with Google’s executive team.

Fluency in AI/GenAI product integration and operational automation.

Proven track record of converting high-touch operational procedures into self-service, automated software solutions.

Demonstrated expertise in managing a distributed team of experienced software engineers of large-scale projects.

Proven track record of growing and building highly effective teams, as well as working with stakeholders and collaborating across organizational boundaries.

roles.title: Director, Head of Product, Google Design Platform
roles.description:
As Director, Product Management for Google Design Platform (GDP), you will own the design systems that underlie all Google products. Your primary responsibility will be to lead GDP’s product mangement team to define the product and strategic direction, technical strategy, and roadmap to bring Google Design into the AI era. You will be an insightful and opinionated strategic leader with a passion and taste for great design, a front-end technologist with deep technical knowledge, and a deft executor who grows in a high-influence service model to drive rapid, impactful results.
Partnering with UX Design, Engineering, User Research, and Program Management Directors, you will steer the evolution of our design systems and AI-powered workflows (e.g., GenUX, design-to-code pipelines, Design Agents) while driving broad adoption across Google Product Areas (e.g., Gemini, Search, Workspace, Android, YouTube).
GDP as a team sits within a broader product area. Core’s mission is to make Google better for everyone, and do so at scale. Core builds foundational technology and experiences that power the Google family of products. Core is the owner and advocate for the cross-Google user experience, underlying design elements, safety and privacy technology, developer platforms, product components, and infrastructure at Google.
Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.  

US: $281000 - $391000 (USD) + 30% bonus target + equity + benefits

Define and execute the product roadmap for the next generation of Google Design systems and AI-driven tooling (GenUX, agentic dev loops) to dramatically elevate designer and developer velocity.

Partner closely with Engineering, Design, Research and Program directors. Advocate for and operationalize the design vision, translating design intent and complex technical constraints into clear, high-quality roadmaps without overstepping into design arbitration.

Operate GDP as a high-value service platform. Treat 1P product areas (Search, Gemini, Android, Workspace, etc.) as enterprise partners, driving adoption, reduction of integration friction, and measurable velocity gains rather than relying on top-down mandates.

Distill complex technical and system strategies into simple, compelling mantras that align cross-functional partners and executive leadership.

Establish a culture of rapid iteration and fearless accountability—avoiding multi-quarter planning traps by balancing fast, tangible developer wins with foundational platform bets.

Qualifications:
Minimum qualifications:
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Human-Computer Interaction (HCI), Design, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

15 years of product management experience in technology organizations.

Experience with AI/LLM-driven workflows, agentic developer loops, or generative UI tooling.

Experience with front-end development and UI infrastructure (e.g., modern web/mobile frameworks, token architectures, build systems, developer tooling).

Preferred qualifications:
Experience defining and scaling platform-level products, developer tools, or design systems at global scale.

Experience with multi-product design systems (e.g., Material Design) and large-scale framework migrations.

Experience managing, mentoring, and growing product management teams.

Ability to drive strategic programs and execute with speed in a highly matrixed, cross-functional service environment.

Technical knowledge including experience with AI/LLM-driven workflows, agentic developer loops, generative UI tooling, front-end development and UI infrastructure, and cross-platform development.

Authentic passion and eye for the craft of design including an appreciation for typography, motion, and interaction design.

roles.title: Director, Operational Technology Security
roles.description:
Google's Data Center Compliance, Strategy, and Risk Management (CSRM) team is integrated across all stages of the data center lifecycle. CSRM is dedicated to protecting the people and assets of Google’s global critical infrastructure. By leveraging advanced security systems, dedicated guarding forces, and risk management and compliance frameworks, CSRM supports the entirety of Google Data Centers (GDC), enabling Google Cloud to reach a broader audience and inspire user trust.
As the Director of Data Center Operational Technology (OT) Security, you will define and execute the global direction, strategy, and governance for securing Google’s physical and operational data center infrastructure. You will lead a high-impact organization responsible for proactively identifying, quantifying, and mitigating complex enterprise-wide cyber and physical threats across critical systems. Serving as a strategic executive partner, you will align cross-functional leadership across Technical Infrastructure, Cloud CISO, and engineering organizations to build next-generation secure architectures, drive industry standards, and safeguard Google Cloud’s global footprint at scale.

The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide. 
We're the driving force behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our cutting-edge AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more.
Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.  

US: $256000 - $356000 (USD) + 30% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities:
Define and direct multi-year security architectures, risk quantification models, and defense-in-depth frameworks for global OT systems, rack-level environments, and critical facilities.

Establish governance mechanisms and executive accountability across GDC, Cloud CISO, Corporate Engineering, and PSS to deliver unified, end-to-end security architectures.

Build, scale, and inspire a global organization of technical managers, engineers, and program leaders. Foster a culture of technical excellence, continuous learning, psychological safety, and leadership.

Serve as the principal advisor to business and engineering executives on emerging OT, cyber, and infrastructure threats, steering multi-year roadmaps and investment strategies to proactively protect critical assets.

Qualifications:
Minimum qualifications:
Bachelor’s degree in a technical discipline or equivalent practical experience.

15 years of experience in technical infrastructure, industrial control systems (e.g., ICS/SCADA), or cyber security engineering, including 7 years of experience in executive leadership, managing teams.

15 years of experience leading technical security programs, risk governance, or critical infrastructure engineering organizations.

Preferred qualifications:
Advanced degree (e.g., Master’s degree or PhD) in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Cyber Security, or a related technical discipline.

20 years of experience leading enterprise-scale OT, ICS/SCADA, and cyber security initiatives across global industrial or critical infrastructure environments.

Executive experience deploying zero-trust or defense-in-depth models across large-scale physical/cyber infrastructure environments.

Ability to navigate high ambiguity, drive organizational change, and deliver high-impact security outcomes across complex hardware and software ecosystems.

Recognized thought leadership in emerging OT security standards, liquid-cooling hardware integration, and threat-modeling frameworks.

You unify these functions to graduate customers along the product adoption maturity curve. A critical mandate involves liaising with GCS PSA Leaders, Global Product Leads, and the Ads Solutions Engineering CoE to deploy excellent implementations. Your team critically assesses customer needs to drive advanced product adoption.
You serve as a product advocate for gTech Ads  for complex technical product deployment. This role balances the operational management of a specialized technical team with the execution of high-impact, regional media and product business strategies.
Operationally, you will guide a high-performing team of Product Deployment Engineers (PDEs) through complex technical projects and advanced implementations. Strategically, you will act as the principal advisor to gTech Ads GCS, owning the complex implementation strategy across the region. You partner with implementation program managers, PSA leads, and regional sales directors to accelerate product adoption.
You will act as a trusted advisor to align technical service delivery with media activation opportunities, balancing engineering support with sales targets and partner with global/regional product leaders and technical program managers to align resource allocation with market-specific goals, guide vendor execution, and provide technical mentorship to engineers. You will collaborate with Ads Solutions Engineering to drive the automation roadmap and development by delivering technical Business Requirement Documents (BRDs) and prioritizing impactGoogle creates products and services that make the world a better place, and gTech’s role is to help bring them to life. Our teams of trusted advisors support customers globally. Our solutions are rooted in our technical skill, product expertise, and a thorough understanding of our customers’ complex needs. Whether the answer is a bespoke solution to solve a unique problem, or a new tool that can scale across Google, everything we do aims to ensure our customers benefit from the full potential of Google products.

To learn more about gTech, check out our video.

Responsibilities:
Integrate gTech's value proposition into GCS sales strategies and adapt global/regional data activation strategies to meet localized market needs alongside PSA counterparts.

Oversee advanced implementations and custom CRM/API workarounds, while actively identifying scaling best practices to transition bespoke fixes into repeatable frameworks.

Partner with cross-cluster product communities and Ads Solutions Engineering (ASE) to define technical tooling requirements (BRDs) that automate and scale implementation delivery. Define best practices and work with agents to scale implementations.

Deploy scarce, high-value technical resources toward high-opportunity sectors, establishing robust metrics and case studies to quantify the business value delivered.

Manage, mentor, and scale a high-performing team of PDEs, fostering a high-impact, and entrepreneurial culture.

Qualifications:
Minimum qualifications:
Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

10 years of experience troubleshooting technical issues for internal/external partners or customers.

3 years of experience in people management.

Experience in either system design or reading code (e.g., Java, C++, Python).

Preferred qualifications:
 Master’s degree in Business, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Engineering or Applied Science, or a related field.

15 years of experience managing projects and working with analytics, software coding, or customer-side web technologies.

Experience building and maintaining internal and external stakeholder networks, with a track record of navigating complex corporate structures to deliver against strategic plans.

Knowledge of the online advertising/customer growth role and familiarity with the ad serving industry and internet technologies.

Ability to navigate highly ambiguous situations, solve complex technical or business problems, and scale solutions.

roles.title: Head of Research, Professional Intelligence
roles.description:
Working alongside our Advanced Agentic team, the Specialized Professional Intelligence team is building domain-specific AI architecture for high-stakes industries that operate on vast, sensitive, and private  
datasets. The team also contributes to the broader Gemini model training effort by building evaluations, datasets and training objectives that measure performance on complex tasks. Additionally, we work on research to see how we can improve agent performance throughout these product surfaces. We are looking for roles across the board for strong infrastructure engineers, front-end engineers, and researchers excited to achieve unprecedented levels of performance.

As an organization, Google maintains a portfolio of research projects driven by fundamental research, new product innovation, product contribution and infrastructure goals, while providing individuals and teams the freedom to emphasize specific types of work. As a Research Scientist, you'll setup large-scale tests and deploy promising ideas quickly and broadly, managing deadlines and deliverables while applying the latest theories to develop new and improved products, processes, or technologies. From creating experiments and prototyping implementations to designing new architectures, our research scientists work on real-world problems that span the breadth of computer science, such as machine (and deep) learning, data mining, natural language processing, hardware and software performance analysis, improving compilers for mobile platforms, as well as core search and much more.As a Research Scientist, you'll also actively contribute to the wider research community by sharing and publishing your findings, with ideas inspired by internal projects as well as from collaborations with research programs at partner universities and technical institutes all over the world.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.  

US: $262000 - $364000 (USD) + 25% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities:
Act like an owner; be fearless in diving deep, asking questions, proposing solutions, establishing consensus and then making things happen.

Lead, mentor, and grow a team of research scientists and machine learning engineers.

Provide direction and focus in areas of high ambiguity while prioritizing team workloads and managing projects to enable rapid iteration on research initiatives.

Oversee the development of benchmark datasets and rigorous evaluation suites measuring factual accuracy, citation fidelity, and multi-step reasoning.

Partner with engineering, product management, and legal domain experts to deploy research advances to early enterprise partners.

Qualifications:
Minimum qualifications:
PhD in Computer Science, Mathematics, Applied Statistics, Machine Learning, or a related quantitative field, or equivalent practical experience.

10 years of experience in applied NLP research and productionization, including experience with advanced prompting, and LLM fine-tuning or reinforcement learning (RL).

4 years of experience leading technical or research teams and mentoring engineers.

Preferred qualifications:
Startup experience iterating fast and exploring multiple strategies to optimize performance.

Exposure to production systems that rely on ML models, or experience with model deployment.

Significant success with building AI software and systems for specific industries, either as research publications at top PL or ML venues, or as open source artifacts.

Track record of delivering high quality solutions to large, complex software problems.

Work Independently, committed to safe, transformative AI, and excellent written and verbal communication and strong stakeholder management across all levels.

Demonstrated ability to deliver clean, maintainable, production-grade code in Python, adhering to sound engineering principles.

roles.title: AI Value Creation Senior Principal
roles.description:
As a Senior AI Value Creation Principal, you will be responsible for developing and driving the value promoting methodology for Google’s AI and Workspace products. You will collaborate with and influence global sales and product teams by using these strategies to accelerate Google Solution adoption. This role combines foundational AI understanding, enterprise business experience, and the ability to translate products into near and long term business impact for the customer.
Success in this role means increased Google Cloud books and business across strategic product areas, and accelerated strategic partnerships. In this role, you will influence executive internal and external stakeholders, and articulate Google Cloud’s differentiators with credibility. As the technology landscape continues to evolve, you will need to artfully navigate change and ambiguity, test new ideas, and pivot when necessary.
Google Cloud helps millions of employees and organizations empower their employees, serve their customers, and build what’s next for their business – all with technology built in the cloud. Our products are engineered for security, reliability, and scalability, running the full stack from infrastructure to applications to devices and hardware. And our teams are dedicated to helping our customers – developers, small and large businesses, educational institutions, and government agencies – see the benefits of our technology come to life.
It's an exciting time to join Google Cloud’s Go-To-Market team, leading the AI revolution for businesses worldwide. You’ll excel by leveraging Google's brand credibility—a legacy built on inventing foundational technologies and proven at scale. We’ll provide you with the world's most advanced AI portfolio, including frontier Gemini models, and the complete Vertex AI platform, helping you to solve business problems. We’re a collaborative culture providing direct access to DeepMind's engineering and research minds, empowering you to solve customer challenges. Join us to be the catalyst for our mission, drive customer success, and define the new cloud era—the market is yours. 
Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

Develop and iterate on a value selling methodology across Google’s AI products. Work cross-functionally to drive broad-based adoption of value selling assets, insights, and resources.

Collaborate with global sales, product, and customer stakeholders to craft compelling value propositions that demonstrate tangible and measurable impact of our technology.

Lead customer centric value pitches development, business cases and TCO analysis, and scalable value templates. 

Leveraging Google, customer, and third-party data, frameworks, models, and tools to justify and accelerate customers’ investment decisions

Brief Cloud sales and engineering leadership on customer patterns and emerging trends in AI, based on customer value engagements.

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

10 years of experience in a technical project management or a customer-facing role. 

Experience with AI technology, and GCP AI products or similar industry products.

roles.title: Associate Principal Analyst, Trust and Safety, Shopping
roles.description:
Trust & Safety team members are tasked with identifying and taking on the biggest problems that challenge the safety and integrity of our products. They use technical know-how, excellent problem-solving skills, user insights, and proactive communication to protect users and our partners from abuse across Google products like Search, Maps, Gmail, and Google Ads. On this team, you're a big-picture thinker and strategic team-player with a passion for doing what’s right. You work globally and cross-functionally with Google engineers and product managers to identify and fight abuse and fraud cases at Google speed - with urgency. And you take pride in knowing that every day you are working hard to promote trust in Google and ensuring the highest levels of user safety.

Trust and Safety Shopping team mission: Deliver safe and trustworthy shopping experiences to all users. We work with a variety of teams from Engineering to Legal, Public Policy and Sales Engineering to set policies and combat fraud and abuse in a scalable way, often with an eye to finding industry-wide solutions. Trust and Safety team members are motivated to find innovative solutions, and use technical know-how, user insights and proactive  communication to pursue the highest possible quality and safety standards for users across Google products.

At Google we work hard to earn our users’ trust every day. Trust & Safety is Google’s team of abuse fighting and user trust experts working daily to make the internet a safer place. We partner with teams across Google to deliver bold solutions in abuse areas such as malware, spam and account hijacking. A team of Analysts, Policy Specialists, Engineers, and Program Managers, we work to reduce risk and fight abuse across all of Google’s products, protecting our users, advertisers, and publishers across the globe in over 40 languages.
Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.  

US: $141000 - $205000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities:
Ideate and manage high impact projects which increase user safety or improve user experience, in partnership with cross-functional stakeholders such as Engineering, Product, Legal, Policy, Sales and other Trust and Safety teams.

Perform investigative fraud and abuse analysis, producing actionable insights and recommendations.

Identify opportunities for new signals, automation, workflow improvements and operational efficiency gains. Subsequently drive solutions/projects to completion.

Mentor and provide guidance to team members.

Perform on-call responsibilities on a rotating basis, including weekend coverage/holidays.
This role works with sensitive content or situations and may be exposed to graphic, controversial, and upsetting topics or content.

Qualifications:
Minimum qualifications:
Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

7 years of experience in data analytics, Trust and Safety, policy, cybersecurity, or related fields.

Preferred qualifications:
Master's or PhD in a relevant field.

Experience with machine learning.

Experience in SQL, building dashboards, data collection/transformation, visualization/dashboards, or experience in a scripting/programming language (e.g. Python).

Excellent communication and presentation skills and the ability to influence cross-functionally at various levels.

Excellent problem-solving and critical thinking skills with attention to detail in an ever-changing environment.

roles.title: Business Operations Principal, Core
roles.description:
Product and Business Strategy Leaders bring together teams across Google’s functions to help products execute optimally. Our team pushes Google to scale at key points that refine our products and infrastructure by executing efficiently, bringing solid business sense and sound judgment, and working effectively across organizational lines.

Our roles often include components of strategy (e.g. analyzing and understanding new trends in the industry, building business plans), operations (e.g. running the cadence of organizations, connecting the operating lines between our functions), and communications. Our team partners with senior leadership to run important functions that cross-cut our existing organizations and deliver high impact projects. We help Engineers, PMs, UX, and all of our other functions to build amazing products that delight our users, and then get those products into their hands.

The Business Operations and Strategy team at Google plays a critical role in defining and driving strategic, operational and organizational improvements across the company. The team, also known as "BizOps", operates like an internal consulting group working on a range of critical projects and issues. 

Google's leadership team hand-picks business challenges, and members of Business Operations (BizOps) work in small teams to find solutions. These include defining and executing our strategy on company-wide priorities like transforming Google into the world’s first AI-native enterprise, shaping the development of AI technologies and products, and developing go-to-market or monetization strategies as Customer Zero of these products. BizOps is at the forefront of Google's fast-moving strategic priorities like AI Transformation, addressing operational challenges and enabling innovation.
The Core team builds the technical foundation behind Google’s flagship products. We are owners and advocates for the underlying design elements, developer platforms, product components, and infrastructure at Google. These are the essential building blocks for excellent, safe, and coherent experiences for our users and drive the pace of innovation for every developer. We look across Google’s products to build central solutions, break down technical barriers and strengthen existing systems. As the Core team, we have a mandate and a unique opportunity to impact important technical decisions across the company.
Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.  

US: $176000 - $256000 (USD) + 20% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities:
Work with the company's executive leadership to define, launch, drive and operational initiatives.

Structure and execute operational and initiatives by developing work plans, gathering and synthesizing relevant data, leading analyses, and developing final recommendations.

Lead cross-functional, global teams to provide direction on the execution of tasks.

Communicate findings to management and to the broader organization.

Drive recommendations through to implementation and results.

Qualifications:
Minimum qualifications:
Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience. 

11 years of experience in management consulting, product management and strategy, or analytics in a technology company. 

Experience working with and analyzing data, and managing multiple cross-functional programs or projects.

Experience leading teams on cross-company initiatives and aligning recommendations with executive leadership.

Preferred qualifications:
Advanced degree or equivalent practical experience. 

Experience with R, SQL, spreadsheets, or similar analytics tools.

Experience working with product and engineering teams.

Excellent communication and presentation skills (written and verbal) and the ability to influence cross-functionally at various levels.

In this high-impact strategic role, your leadership spans the complete architectural continuum between the distributed Control Plane and the foundational Data Plane. Across the control plane, you will architect robust, scalable defenses for multi-tenant orchestration, resource lifecycle management, zero-trust identity and access boundaries, supply-chain integrity, and high-assurance compliance for regulated and public-sector cloud environments. Across the node data plane, you will lead deep systems security architecture across hypervisors, virtual machine monitors (VMMs), host operating systems, kernel subsystems, and hardware-level isolation mechanisms.
Crucially, you will navigate a rapidly transforming threat landscape shaped by the emergence of agentic threat vectors enabled through advanced LLMs, where automated, AI-driven vulnerability discovery and exploit generation compress attacker timelines to machine speed. You will lead proactive defense-in-depth across the platform - mitigating hardware and microarchitectural CPU vulnerabilities (e.g., speculative execution, transient execution side-channels, and address space isolation), eliminating memory safety exploitation risks across the virtualization stack, and advancing host deprivileging and zero-trust host architectures.
Furthermore, you will advocate for next-generation virtualization security designs - leveraging custom silicon for isolation, establishing multi-domain security boundaries, and architecting secure runtime substrates for next-generation AI workloads, high-density sandboxed execution environments, and massive accelerator clusters.
Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

Formulate architectural and operational defenses to counter the rapid emergence of autonomous agentic threat vectors and LLM-assisted exploitation tools, establishing automated vulnerability discovery, proactive mitigation frameworks, and rapid incident response capabilities across the fleet.

Architect robust, hardware-level defenses and isolation boundaries to eliminate and mitigate hardware CPU vulnerabilities, speculative execution side-channels, transient execution threats, and cross-tenant leakage

Lead security defenses and privilege reduction across hypervisor technologies, virtual machine monitors (VMMs), host kernels, and low-level runtimes, implementing sandboxing and defense against virtualization escapes.

In this role, you will be responsible for orchestrating these migrations across a massive compute fleet, mitigating high-stakes guest-to-host escapes and insider threat vectors, and ensuring near bare-metal performance and absolute reliability for mission-critical enterprise workloads. Crucially, you will drive agentic coding workflows—partnering with infrastructure AI teams to design, evaluate, and scale agentic code transformation, including C++-to-Rust code translation, automated code generation and refactoring, and AI-assisted behavioral test synthesis. You will also lead the incorporation of advanced formal verification tools (e.g., Lean, TLA+, Verus) to prove program correctness

Google’s innovative search and AI technologies connect millions of people with information every day. The Android XR team is extending this mission into the physical world by creating the ultimate spatial computing platform. As a Principal Multimodal LLM Research Scientist, you will lead the research that defines the future of spatial intelligence. You will lead a team of researchers to push the boundaries of deep learning, pre-training, and multimodal understanding. Your research will directly influence the core capabilities of Google’s XR products, enabling them to understand complex, multi-sensory environments and interact with users in natural, context-aware ways.
The Platforms and Devices team encompasses Google's various computing software platforms across environments (desktop, mobile, applications), as well as our first party devices and services that combine the best of Google AI, software, and hardware. Teams across this area research, design, and develop new technologies to make our user's interaction with computing faster and more seamless, building innovative experiences for our users around the world.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.  

US: $307000 - $427000 (USD) + 30% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities:
Lead a research agenda focused on state-of-the-art multimodal pre-training, architecture design, and novel deep learning techniques for spatial computing.

Develop groundbreaking models that integrate vision, audio, and sensor data to provide a unified understanding of the physical world.

Publish original research in machine learning and computer vision conferences (e.g., NeurIPS, CVPR, ICML) to advance the field and represent Google’s leadership.

Translate fundamental research breakthroughs into scalable technical strategies for the Android XR product organization.

Mentor research scientists and engineers, providing technical direction and fostering an environment of high-impact innovation.

Qualifications:
Minimum qualifications:
Bachelor’s degree in a technical field (Computer Science, AI, Physics) or equivalent practical experience.

15 years of experience in deep learning research, with a focus on multimodal or language models.

Experience leading research teams and delivering technological innovations.

Experience with modern deep learning frameworks and distributed training on clusters.

Preferred qualifications:
PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related field with a focus on Multimodal AI or Computer Vision.

Ability to bridge the gap between theoretical research and practical implementation on consumer-facing hardware.

Deep specialized expertise in state-of-the-art multimodal pre-training strategies and transformer-based architectures.

Significant publication record in venues demonstrating leadership in the AI research community.

roles.title: Principal, Hardware, Data Centers Robotics
roles.description:
The AI and Infrastructure (AI2) team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide. As Principal Engineer, you will define the strategic and technical direction for PIE Robotics roadmap. 
In this role, you will lead the strategy and technical development of Data Center hardware robotics systems. You will lead internally and externally, to deliver the robotics automation solutions to enable our scale up and out hardware deployment, repair operations, and final decommission.
The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide.

Responsibilities:
Scope and develop advanced robotics automation technical solutions for data center hardware required for AI2 business transformation.

Collaborate closely with executive leadership, internal and external, regarding AI2's data Center Robotics strategy and ecosystem development.

Source and ensure AI2 captures the latest Robotics and AI technologies and solutions from the ecosystem, and rapidly deploy within AI2, to meet the business needs.

Lead engineering execution and provide technical leadership for product features and delivery. Oversee the end-to-end deployment of autonomous mobile robots (AMRs), automated guided vehicles (AGVs), and multi-axis robotic arms for handling delicate data center hardware.

Qualifications:
Minimum qualifications:
PhD degree in Robotics or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

15 years of experience in robotics systems engineering or architecture, and experience with technical innovation.

Experience in the robotics industry, leading robotics applications development and turning Research and Development (R&D) into deployed, real world systems.

Experience in robotic control, planning, kinematics, and mechatronic systems.

Preferred qualifications:
Experience with embedded systems (e.g., RTOS, microcontrollers, FPGA), sensor fusion, and actuator control.

Experience implementing foundational vision-language-action (VLA) models, imitation learning, and reinforcement learning (RL) pipelines to teach robots dynamic object manipulation.

Experience executing low-latency teleoperation infrastructure, haptic feedback integration, and human-in-the-loop systems for complex, remote hardware interventions and data collection.

Familiarity with motion control systems and robotics programming languages (e.g. Robot Operating System) or similar frameworks.

Practical understanding of recent advancements in the robotics field, specifically the application of general-purpose bipedal/wheeled humanoid platforms for flexible, human-centric data center tasks.

roles.title: Product Strategy and Operations Principal, Cloud AI
roles.description:
Product and Business Strategy Leaders bring together teams across Google’s functions to help products execute optimally. Our team pushes Google to scale at key points that refine our products and infrastructure by executing efficiently, bringing solid business sense and sound judgment, and working effectively across organizational lines.

Our roles often include components of strategy (e.g. analyzing and understanding new trends in the industry, building business plans), operations (e.g. running the cadence of organizations, connecting the operating lines between our functions), and communications. Our team partners with senior leadership to run important functions that cross-cut our existing organizations and deliver high impact projects. We help Engineers, PMs, UX, and all of our other functions to build amazing products that delight our users, and then get those products into their hands.

Cloud AI aims to enable the world's enterprises to undertake digital transformation through AI technologies and powerful solutions designed to create real business value.

As the Principal of Product Strategy and Operations (PS&O) for Cloud AI, you will lead the evolution from legacy cloud AI structures to Agentic ecosystems. You will be responsible for the Intelligent Data Platform roadmap, moving the organization from a reactive What data do we have? posture to a proactive, intent-driven What data do we need? architecture. This role is for a leader who can bridge the gap between high-level statistical modeling and global operational scale. You will sit at the intersection of generative AI development and commercial execution. You will act as a strategic partner to VP level leadership, translating complex AI infrastructure needs into actionable business roadmaps and GTM strategies.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.  

US: $176000 - $256000 (USD) + 20% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities:
Lead the strategic pivot from legacy cloud operations to an AI-native posture, identifying high-impact AI-ification opportunities that drive 10x rather than 10% growth/efficiency gain.

Architect the transition toward vibe coding platforms where human domain knowledge is codified into agentic systems, allowing non-technical stakeholders to interact with hyperscale data through natural intent.

Lead the transition from fragmented data silos to a unified data engineering platform.

Lead strategic analysis that informs Cloud’s AI strategy such as identifying impacts of accelerating growth through ISV and SI partners, analyzing opportunity size for products, or identifying of business acceleration through customer cohort analysis.

Work directly with VP leaders to support day-to-day decision making through timely analysis, excellent people management skills to drive alignment, and effective presentation skills.

Qualifications:
Minimum qualifications:
Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience. 

11 years of experience in management consulting, product management and strategy, or analytics in a technology company. 

Experience working with and analyzing data, and managing multiple cross-functional programs or projects.

Experience building go-to-market strategies.

Preferred qualifications:
Experience with advanced SQL, Python, and BigQuery.

Understanding of enterprise software business models.

Ability to deconstruct complex, legacy operations and architect an Agentic AI replacement that achieves a step-function improvement in throughput or time-to-insight

Ability to identify problems, design projects to address, execute with little guidance, and guide the work of more junior team members.

Ability to independently drive complex projects with multiple executive stakeholders to successful completion.

Ability to ramp up quickly on a wide range of topics from accounting business recognition to AI/ML applications.

Drive hardware-software co-design efforts to optimize model performance for constrained Edge-AI environments, focusing on latency, power, and memory efficiency.

Collaborate cross-functionally with Silicon, Android OS, and Google Research teams to define the long-term roadmap for spatial intelligence.

Mentor senior technical leads and staff engineers, fostering a culture of technical excellence and innovative problem-solving across the organization.

roles.title: APAC Transportation Operations Manager
roles.description:
A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Program Manager at Google, you’ll lead complex, multi-disciplinary projects from start to finish — working with stakeholders to plan requirements, manage project schedules, identify risks, and communicate clearly with cross-functional partners across the company. Your projects will often span offices, time zones, and hemispheres. It's your job to coordinate the players and keep them up to date on progress and deadlines. 

We are part of the Global transportation team who manages the full lifecycle of transportation operations, ensuring reliable, secure, and sustainable movement of goods. Core responsibilities include Transportation Enablement and Execution, Transportation Management System (TMS) Planning, and Carrier Diversification to enhance network flexibility and performance. Additionally, the team upholds Transportation Security standards and drives Sustainability initiatives to reduce environmental impact while supporting efficient, future-ready logistics operations.

This team manages the end-to-end transportation across 13 APAC countries, Including over 100 suppliers and 6 contract manufacturers through multimodal transport network including air, road, ocean Full Container Load/Less than Container Load (FCL/LCL), and sea-air solutions. We run the daily execution of all transportation activities for IN and OUT of APAC region. We ensure on-time delivery and we manage disruptions to protect regional supply chain velocity and performance.
Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. We're proud to be our engineers' engineers and love voiding warranties by taking things apart so we can rebuild them. We keep our networks up and running, ensuring our users have the best and fastest experience possible.

Responsibilities:
Create a process to support transportation shipments within google for CMs and suppliers. Set a new control tower support and best practices for shipment management.

Work on end to end shipments for CMs and suppliers serving as the primary regional escalation contact for carrier delays, customs clearance, and disruptions.

Analyze freight spend and evaluating mode shifts (air vs. ocean/road) to minimize expedite costs.

Operate Control Tower systems independently to monitor shipments and leverage AI tools to automate routine tasks.

Create standard operating procedures, playbooks, runbooks, and templates to break information silos through open, transparent communication.

Qualifications:
Minimum qualifications:
Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

7 years of experience analyzing data and generating business insights.

7 years of experience developing operational process solutions, and working with cross-functional teams.

5 years of experience managing transportation as shipper side with involvement in Contract manufactures or OEM suppliers.

5 years of experience working with, supervising, and managing third-party logistics relationships and managing control towers as shipper and setting metrics or third-party Logistics.

Preferred qualifications:
MBA or Master's degree in a related field or CSCMP certification.

7 years of experience using data analysis to drive decision making.

7 years of experience building relationships with stakeholders or clients.

5 years of experience working and improving the process for shipping forecasts for Air cargo.

Experience in data center equipment environments or computer component manufacturing.

Excellent problem-solving skills with the ability to apply structured thinking and logic to your work and provide solutions to challenges.

roles.title: ASIC Design Verification Manager, TPU Compute
roles.description:
In this role, you’ll work to shape the future of AI/ML hardware acceleration. You will have an opportunity to drive cutting-edge TPU (Tensor Processing Unit) technology that powers Google's most demanding AI/ML applications. You’ll be part of a team that pushes boundaries, developing custom silicon solutions that power the future of  Google's TPU. You'll contribute to the innovation behind products loved by millions worldwide, and leverage your design and verification expertise to verify complex digital designs, with a specific focus on TPU architecture and its integration within AI/ML-driven systems.

As an ASIC Design Verification Manager for Google's TPU designs, you will lead a team and own the functional verification for key components by guiding the development of advanced infrastructure at the subchip, subsystem, and full-chip levels. This includes developing comprehensive test plans, writing diagnostic codes, and building monitors and checkers to ensure quality assurance.
Additionally, you will collaborate closely with front-end design, architecture, and performance teams. By analyzing coverage across multiple dimensions, you will guarantee architectural compliance, ensure functional correctness, and drive your team to meet critical performance goals.
The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide. 
We're the driving force behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our cutting-edge AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more.
Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.  

US: $192000 - $278000 (USD) + 20% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities:
Lead the functional verification team for significant portions of TPU Compute team, setting and communicating individual and team priorities that support organizational goals, providing regular feedback and coaching, and developing advanced functional verification infrastructure such as subchip, subsystem, and fullchip level environments.

Define and drive the execution of comprehensive verification strategies for complex compute subsystems, working with cross-functional design, architecture and power teams to achieve architectural compliance and alignment with performance and power goal.

Architect scalable, reusable verification environments and flows, driving the adoption of industry-leading methodologies to improve efficiency across the team.

Provide technical leadership and mentorship to junior engineers, drive code reviews, establish verification quality standards, and guide cross-functional efforts for silicon bring-up.

Partner with architects and design leads to influence micro-architectural decisions to improve verification throughput and overall quality.

Qualifications:
Minimum qualifications:
Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

10 years of experience with verification, SystemVerilog, and UVM.

3 years of experience in people management.

Preferred qualifications:
Master's degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering or Computer Science, with an emphasis on computer architecture.

12 years of experience with industry-standard tools, languages, and methodologies relevant to the development and verification of high-performance silicon.

Experience leading verification efforts of complex SoC projects, involving compute subsystems for AI/ML accelerators.

Experience mentoring junior engineers and establishing verification quality standards with excellent investigative and communication skills.

Proven record of managing verification planning for SoCs, from architecture definition to silicon bring-up.

Ability to influence cross-functional teams (architecture, design, power, emulation, software) to optimize verification efficiency and product quality.

roles.title: Assembly and Integration Center Operations Manager
roles.description:

GCL enables Alphabet stakeholders and customers to predictably deliver the equipment that provides compute, storage, and networking capacity globally.
We are committed to:
Exceeding customer expectations through dependable and agile operations and optimizing costs via strategic transportation and carrier management. We strengthen supply chain resilience by mitigating risks, diversifying suppliers, and leveraging real-time monitoring and cultivate a culture of growth and opportunity.

Manage the day-to-day 3PL partner operations, floor staging, and physical layout across the Atlanta Integration Center, overseeing labor forecasting and directing the scaling of floor personnel (including transitioning to 24/7 schedules during high-volume periods) to support burst deployments.

roles.title: Partner Forward Deployed Engineering Manager III, GenAI, Google Cloud
roles.description:
As a Manager of a GenAI Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) team, you are an embedded builder who bridges the gap between frontier AI products and production-grade reality within partners for our customers. Unlike traditional advisory roles, you will function as an innovator-builder, moving beyond high-level architecture to code, debug, and jointly ship bespoke and scalable agentic solutions directly with our partners, for and within the customer’s environment. This role is designed for high-agency engineers with a founder’s mindset. You will address blockers to production including solving the integration complexities, data readiness issues, and state-management issues that prevent AI from reaching enterprise-grade maturity. By embedding with strategic partners, you will serve a dual purpose: providing white glove deployment of complex AI systems and acting as a critical connector and feedback loop for the partner to Google, transforming real-world field and partner insights into Google Cloud’s future product roadmap. You will serve as the agent engineer bridging the gap between AI prototypes and production-grade reality for our strategic AI partners and their own FDE teams.It's an exciting time to join Google Cloud’s Go-To-Market team, leading the AI revolution for businesses worldwide. You’ll excel by leveraging Google's brand credibility—a legacy built on inventing foundational technologies and proven at scale. We’ll provide you with the world's most advanced AI portfolio, including frontier Gemini models, and the complete Vertex AI platform, helping you to solve business problems. We’re a collaborative culture providing direct access to DeepMind's engineering and research minds, empowering you to solve customer challenges. Join us to be the catalyst for our mission, drive customer success, and define the new cloud era—the market is yours.

Serve as a team lead and developer within the Google Cloud partner FDE organization to drive the transition from  rapid prototypes to production-grade, replicable agentic workflows (multi-agent systems, MCP servers) that drive measurable Return on Investment (ROI).

Build high-performance evaluation pipelines and observability frameworks to ensure partner developed agentic systems meet requirements for accuracy, safety, and latency.

Identify repeatable partner and field patterns and friction points in Google’s AI stack, converting them into reusable modules or formal product feature requests for the Engineering teams.

Co-build with a strategic AI partner’s own Forward Deployed Engineering teams to instill Google-grade development best practices, ensuring long-term project success and high end-user adoption.

Help partners to build their own agentic delivery capabilities to set them up for long-term success, focusing on the ROI at customer engagements ensuring customer activation.

roles.title: Product Engineering Manager, Compute and Storage
roles.description:
Be part of a team that pushes boundaries, developing custom silicon solutions that power the future of Google's direct-to-consumer products. You'll contribute to the innovation behind products loved by millions worldwide. Your expertise will shape the next generation of hardware experiences, delivering unparalleled performance, efficiency, and integration.
As the Compute and Storage Product Engineer Lead, you will sit at the epicenter of Google's AI infrastructure ambitions, bridging the gap between hardware design and high-volume global manufacturing. Our team is responsible for ensuring next-generation ARM Compute and Storage hardware is manufacturable, testable, and reliable at scale. By driving Design for Excellence (DFx), developing test strategies, and solving complex production issues, we directly enable the expansion of Google’s infrastructure.
As the Product Engineering Lead, you will guide a talented team of Product Engineers managing our portfolio of ARM compute and storage products. Serving as the technical lead for the Supply Chain NPI teams, you will act as the direct counterpart to the Hardware Engineering TL. You will build and optimize capital efficiency, minimize waste, and accelerate the deployment of the hardware powering Google’s AI future.
Your team is accountable for delivering a working product, ensuring factory readiness, establishing product quality at General Availability (GA), and mitigating technical risks. You will drive Design for Excellence (DFx), develop test strategies, execute NPI builds, improve factory yields, and manage manufacturing fallout and interdependencies.
The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide.
We're the driving force behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our cutting-edge AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more.
Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.  

US: $171000 - $247000 (USD) + 20% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities:
Serve as the NPI Operations Technical Lead, driving reviews between Design and Operations to deliver key manufacturing plans, test strategies, and DFx.

Provide pre-production build support, manage line bring-up, deliver product debug training, and lead yield-bridge analysis to optimize quality.

Evaluate new product technology, collaborating with Engineering and NPI Operations to influence design, highlight risks, and build mitigation plans.

Partner with Quality/Reliability Engineers to set yield goals, validate qualification plans, and lead cross-functional resolutions for component quality excursions.

Manage second-source part qualifications and coordinate Bill of Materials (BOM) updates to ensure continuous production.

Qualifications:
Minimum qualifications:
Bachelor's degree in Engineering or equivalent practical experience.

10 years of experience in manufacturing or hardware design.

3 years of experience in people management.

Experience in Printed Circuit Board Assembly (PCBA) and related system assembly.

Experience in design for manufacturability and serviceability.

Preferred qualifications:
Master's degree in Engineering or Electrical Engineering.

15 years of experience at a company developing hardware products in an extended workforce supply chain (CM and JDM products).

Experience working with ODMs, contract manufacturers and component suppliers for data center server products (especially ARM servers).

Experience in scaled manufacturing, including manufacturing process and line design, bring up and optimization, driving root cause analysis, corrective actions and continuous process improvements.

Experience in bring-up or bench testing hardware in a lab environment.
